text: {"reason":"Add a high-confidence gate to remove costly false arbitrations with confidence 0.44, 0.60, 0.61, 0.66, and 0.67 while preserving the magnitude, exposure, and frozen-horizon checks. V1 produced 20/28 false arbitrations (0.714) despite recall 1.0, so this single gate targets those failures without altering the core trigger.","source":"(define (should-arbitrate? edi-change inventory-exposure) (and (> (abs (change-pct edi-change)) 0.15) (> inventory-exposure 500000) (not (frozen-horizon? edi-change)) (high-confidence? edi-change)))"}
